Deprecated: update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_incrementally

Source: R/deprecated-update-NIW-IA.R
update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_incrementally.Rd

update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_incrementally() was deprecated in MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0 and will be removed in 0.2.0. Please use update_template() instead.

update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_batch() was deprecated in MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0 and will be removed in 0.2.0. Please use update_template() instead.

update_NIW_beliefs_incrementally() was deprecated in MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0 and will be removed in 0.2.0. Please use update_template() instead.

Usage

update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_incrementally(
  prior_model,
  exposure,
  exposure.category = "category",
  exposure.cues = get_cue_labels(prior_model),
  exposure.order = NULL,
  noise_treatment = "no_noise",
  lapse_treatment = "no_lapses",
  method = "label-certain",
  keep.update_history = TRUE,
  keep.exposure_data = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

update_NIW_ideal_adaptor_batch(
  prior_model,
  exposure,
  exposure.category = "category",
  exposure.cues = get_cue_labels(prior_model),
  noise_treatment = "no_noise",
  verbose = FALSE
)

update_NIW_beliefs_incrementally(prior_model, exposure, ...)

Arguments

prior_model

An NIW S7 ideal-adaptor model.

exposure

Observation data.

exposure.category

Name of the category column.

exposure.cues

Cue columns.

exposure.order

Deprecated ordering column.

noise_treatment

Noise treatment.

lapse_treatment

Lapse treatment.

method

Updating method.

keep.update_history

Whether to return intermediate models.

keep.exposure_data

Deprecated and ignored.

verbose

Whether to print additional output.

Value

An updated S7 model or model history.

See also

update_template()
